articles.title: Don Cooper, pitching coach for White Sox’s 2005 World Series championship team, dies at 70
articles.description: Don Cooper, a longtime Chicago White Sox pitching coach who helped the franchise win the 2005 World Series, died at 70, the team announced Wednesday afternoon. The cause has not been revealed.

articles.title: From magical summer to September swoon, Chicago became the ‘baseball center of the earth’ again
articles.description: It was a thrilling baseball summer in Chicago, where the White Sox charmed and the Cubs captivated. What will the fall bring?

articles.title: White Sox scouting director Mike Shirley resigns after verbal harassment allegations
articles.description: Before his resignation, the White Sox placed Shirley on administrative leave following an anonymous tip about his conduct.

articles.title: With one swing, Munetaka Murakami provides relief for ailing White Sox
articles.description: Until recently, the Sox’s season has been an unquestioned success. Now, nine games are left to decide how this season will be judged.

articles.title: Guardians thoughts: Rotation strategies, José Ramírez’s outlook and a White Sox showdown
articles.description: The Guardians sit a half-game behind the White Sox and need to sweep the series to earn the tiebreaker. They're all in the mission.
